tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i sbyin sreg bzhugs// ༄༅// gsum pa mjug gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i man ngag ni/ las sbyor 'grub pa'i gnad yin te/ rnal 'byor pas 'di'i bsnyen sgrub ci rigs pa thon pa na/ gang du bya ba'i gnas dben zhing rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i nub phyogs kyi cha'am/ bden bral du maṇḍal dmar po mda' skor ma cig gi steng du/ rin po che dbang gi thab khung zla gam dmar po rgyar khru gang ba/ zabs su kha khyer nas brtsis te/ rang gi chag khru phyed pa cig byas pa'i mthil du/ padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ rdo rje rgya gram mam/ lcags kyus mtshan zhing*/ yang thag khung gi mthil nas rang gi rtse sor bzhi phyir byin gyis gzhol bar dor nas/ yar gyen la dpangs su sor bzhi brtsigs pa'i kha khyer phyir rang gi rtse sor bzhi dor nas/ nang du byin gyis gzhol bar byas pa'i khor yug kun tu/ rigs bdag snang mtha'i phyag mtshan me tog padma dang yal 'dab dang ze'u 'bru la sogs pas shin tu rgyas pa'i ri mos mdzes par byas shing*/ thab de'i phyi rol du sor gnyis dor bar stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa'i zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje rtse gsum pa res mtshan pa/ stegs bu de'i phyi rol gyi maṇḍal gyi logs zur rnams kyi tha mar rdo rje'i phreng bas shin tu mdzes par bskor zhing*/ stegs bu dang phreng ba'i me ri de dag gi bar gyi phyogs bzhir rnam snang la sogs pa bde bar gshegs pa bzhi'i phyag mtshan/ shar nas g.yas skor du rnam snang gi phyag mtshan 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa dang*/ rin 'byung gi rin po che zur gsum 'bar ba dang*/ snang mtha'i padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ don grub kyi ral gri ljang sngon sor drug pas mtshan pa rnams legs par bris la/ yang thab khung gi phyi nang thams cad du/ padma dang*/ ku mu ta dang*/ ug chos la sogs pa'i me tog dmar po dngos sam bris pa'i tshul gyis sel mar gcal du bkram ste/

de nas rang 'dug pa'i g.yon phyogs su/ mchod gtor gyi gdan khru gang ba'i dbus su/ padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ gtor ma bzang ba rgyan ldan gsum mam/ bzhi tsam bshams la ci rigs par dbul zhing*/ yang g.yas phyogs su yam shing la sogs pa'i gdan khru gang ba'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'am/ chos 'byung bris pa'i steng du/ bsreg rdzas/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu dmar po 'byung ba'i shing gi rigs dang*/ padma che chung dang*/ ku mu ta dmar po dang*/ thang ma sgron shing ngam shug pa la sogs pa'i shing thang chu 'byung ba'i rigs dang*/ khyad par du yang dbang gi yam shing la/ tsandan dmar po/ seng ldeng*/ pa la sha ka ra bī ra dang*/ bil ba'i shing dang*/ mdzo mo shing dang*/ tsam pa ka'i me tog dang*/ me tog dang shing thog dmar po'i rigs gzhan yang ji snyed pa dang*/ zhun mar dang*/ 'bru mar dang*/ dkar gsum mdar gsum dang*/ ske tshe dang*/ lan tshwa dang*/ mngar gsum dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ zho zan dang*/ 'bras chan dang*/ 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru sna dang*/ dar sna dang*/ rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs pa dang*/ sman sna/ rtswa ku sha dang*/ dūr ba dang*/ pri yang ku/ rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi la sogs pa drag po'i rdzas ma gtogs pa rnams sta gon legs par byas la/ de nas rnal 'byor pas rang gi mi bskyod pa la tsandan dmar po'i phye ma btab pa'i chus lus ril po'am/ yan lag smad lnga tsam khrus byas te/ thog mar bsang gtor gyi chu la/ rang gis khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bsgom bzlas cung zad byas la/ de nas lag pa g.yas pas rtswa ku sha'am/ rdo rje'i rtse mos bsang gtor gyi chu nas gtor zhing*/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis rang dang*/ gnas khang dang*/ mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i skyon dang dri ma'i rigs thams cad phyir bsangs la/

de nas sgrub pa po rang gis dar la sogs pa'i gos dmar po mdzes shing gsar pa gyon zhing*/ rdzas dmar po yang btags nas 'bol stan la sogs pa'i stan ches mthon po la/ spyod lam rdo rje skyil krung ngam phyed krung gis/ dbang la kha nub bam/ dbang ldan du bltas la 'dug ste/ thog mar bla ma dkon mchog yi dam dang bcas pa la skyabs 'gro mang du bya zhing*/ de nas khyad par gyi sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bsgoms pa'i nang du/ rang yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa de/ 'dir sku mdog dmar po bskyed nas/ de'i snying po bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ sngar bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams dbul zhing*/ skabs 'dir so sor bsngo/ de'i rjes la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ dbang gi thab khung du sngar gyi bud shing gi rigs rnams zla gam gyi rnam par kha khyer bas cung zad dma' bar bcer ba rnams/ hūm̐ ngam hrīḥgang rung las lha'i gzhal yas khang*/ nang yangs shing phyi rol rgya che ba/ phyi nang thams cad shin tu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bskyed pa'i bar du/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar ba'i nang du/ padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi khar/ ram̐ las 'jig rten pa'i me lha sku mdog shin tu dmar ba/ sku shin tu rid cing zhal gcig 'dzum la khro ba/ spyan gsum rab tu g.yo ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyi skyabs sbyin dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis dbyu gu gsum pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku la rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu skra/ sma ra/ smin ma rnams dmar ser can/ zhabs gnyis kyis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ra skyes kham pa la zhon pa/ drang srong gi cha byad can gsal bar bskyed la/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las/ 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/

lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas te/ tshur sbyon tshur sbyon me lha che// lha yi drang srong bram ze'i mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhed slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha'i gnas shar lho mtshams nas ye shes pa'i me lha snga ma lta bu drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis yongs su bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ mchod rdzas rnams kyis mchod/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ mi ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod pa byas la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ dam tshig pa la gnyis med du bstim zhing*/ me lha de'i snying gar pad nyi'i gdan la/ rang gi sa bon las dbang gi lha khro bo 'dod rgyal yab yum bskyed cing*/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug byas te/ de nas klu shing bra ma/ nim pa la dpal 'bar byas la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ rlung g.yab dang bcas pas me sbar zhing*/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs la 'bul/ de nas yam shing dang bcas pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams yi ge gsum gyis bdud rtsi lnga la mchod yon la sogs pa'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pas brgyan par byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin byas pa'i mtheb srin gnyis kyis bzung nas g.yas su bskor zhing*/ shin tu gus pas rim pas dbul zhing*/ de yang thog mar me lha 'khor bcas la/ oṃ agna ye wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥswā hā/ zhes pas brgya tsam 'bul/ de'i rjes la dbang gi lha khro bo 'dod rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyi zhal cung zad gdangs par bsams pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i ljags kyi rtse mor rang gi sa bon hrīḥlta bu nyid kyis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis drangs shing gsol bas shin tu mnyes shing tshim nas/

sgrub pa po la dngos grub gnang bar bsams te/ rang gi snying po'i sngags gang yin gyi gsham du/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod pas brgya rtsa'am/ stong rtsa la sogs pa ci rigs su phul te/ 'dir me legs par 'bar ba na/ dge mi dge'i me pra yang yid kyis brtags la/ mi pra dge na/ gdon bgegs la sogs mi 'byung bas shin tu dga' ba bsgom zhing*/ gal te mi dge ba'i rtags shig byung na gdon bgegs la sogs 'byung srid pas/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis rdzas rnams bsangs la re zhig dbul zhing*/ dge ba la brtson pas bzlog par bya gsungs/ de yang dge ba'i rtags ni/ me lce'i rnam pa nyi 'od ltar// shin tu dmar zhing g.yas su 'khyil// nag nog med cing snum la mdzes// dud pa med cing dri zhim ldan// 'bar sla me lce mi chad cing*// pi wang rdza rnga la sogs pa'i// rol mo'i sgra mchog yid 'ong sgrogs// bkra shis rtag brgyad gzugs ldan zhing*// lha yi phyag mtshan dbyibs 'dra sogs/ dge ba'i rtags mtshan yin zhes gsungs// yang mi dge ba'i rtags mtshan ni/ me lce 'bar ka dud pa che// dum bur chad cing me stag 'phro// drag po sgra ldan dri mi zhim// rtse gsum sprin 'dra ba glang mgo /gsal shing dbyibs 'dra rtsub cing nub// mdor na mdog dbyibs mi sdug cing*// yi gar mi 'ong sna tshogs rnams// mi dge'i rtags mtshan yin zhes gsungs// sbyin sreg zin pa'i mthar tshogs la rol zhing*/ thal mo sbyar bas me tog bzung ste/ gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par bzhes// zhes brjod pas/ nyes skyon rnams yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la bzod par gsol zhing*/ rang gi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don la gsol ba drag tu btab la/ cho ga dang*/ bzlas brjod dang*/ rdzas yo byad la sogs pa'i lhag chad rnams/

oṃ badzra sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas kha bskangs nas/ mthar/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ces brjod pa'i rjes la/ dbang gi lha rnams la/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pa dang*/ me lha rnams la/ oṃ agna ye gatstshaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ se gol gdab pas so so'i gnas su gshegs su gsol te/ mthar sbyin sreg gi thal ba la sogs pa rnams/ gzhan don dge ba'i yid kyis/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas dor ba dang*/ sems can ci rigs pa rnams la sbyin pa la sogs pa byas la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas te/ dga' ston rgya chen po la rol bar bya gsung*/ de ltar na rang gi dbang gi sngags kyi bsnyen pa ci tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg tshul bzhin ci 'grub byas na/ lhag chad la sogs pa'i skyon rnams dag nas/ shin tu dbang du bsdu ba'i 'grub thag nye zhing*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnams myur du 'byung bar nges gsung*/ rin po che dbang gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i man ngag bla ma ba ri ba la sogs pa'i zhal nas byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dam pa/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas gzhan don du rgyas par bkod pa rdzogs so// //'di yang shin tu gnad che bas/ gzhan la gsang ba gal che/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
